milestone: L2 determinism (--strict --verify, bitwise-identical repeat) for in-VM networking (DNS, TCP sockets, HTTP) inside a QEMU-Linux VM under Hermit
guest_command: qemu-system-x86_64 -nodefaults -nic none -m 256M -accel tcg,thread=single -smp 1 -icount shift=0,sleep=off -rtc base=utc,clock=vm -kernel /boot/vmlinuz -initrd <run>/initramfs.cpio.gz -display none -serial stdio -monitor none -no-reboot -append 'console=ttyS0 panic=-1 rdinit=/init'
networking_scope: in-guest loopback only (no QEMU NIC; -nic none). DNS via /etc/hosts, TCP+HTTP over 127.0.0.1. External-egress networking intentionally out of scope (not L2-deterministic without record/replay).

verify.harness_verdict: QEMU strict L2 in-VM network boot passed.

excluded_evidence: boot.stderr / verifier.stderr (--log info DETLOG dumps, tens of MB; >2 MiB, regenerate by rerun)
